title: Understanding Bluff and Fold in Texas Hold'em
summaryJa: ポーカーの「ブラフ」と「フォールド」は基本的なテクニックです。ブラフは弱いハンドで強いふりをすることで、フォールドは自分のハンドを降りることです。
segments: Texas Hold'em is a popular card game. Players try to win money by making the best hand or by tricking other players.
Two important words in Texas Hold'em are "bluff" and "fold. " Learning these words helps you understand the game better.
A bluff is when you bet money even though you have a weak hand. You want other players to think you have a strong hand.
For example, you have only two low cards. But you bet a large amount of money.
Other players see your big bet. They think you must have good cards.
So they fold their cards and leave the game. You win the pot without showing your cards.
To fold means to quit the current hand. You give up your cards and stop playing that round.
Folding is a smart choice when your hand is not good. For example, the flop shows three cards on the table.
You have weak cards that do not match these three cards. Another player bets a lot of money.
You think you cannot win. So you fold.
You lose the money you already put in, but you save money because you do not bet more. Good players know when to bluff and when to fold.
Bluffing can help you win pots you should lose. Folding can save your money when you have a bad hand.
Both bluff and fold are important skills. Practice using these skills, and you will become a better player.
